title: Ghostty 1.4
why_read: A major version release of a popular, well-engineered terminal emulator, useful to read for anyone interested in terminal UX or GPU-accelerated rendering.
analysis: Ghostty is a GPU-accelerated terminal emulator written in Zig that has gained a strong following for its performance and clean design. A 1.4 release likely brings new features, bug fixes, and platform support that matter to developers who spend their day in a terminal. The high engagement reflects genuine enthusiasm from a technical audience rather than hype about an unrelated topic.
